title: Design System: College Helper / مساعد الجامعة

display.purpose: Monumental cover titles on auth pages only.

headline.purpose: Empty-sheet title, two rules tall (1.875rem phone, 2.25rem sm+).

title.purpose: Headings inside answers, set in print.

body-read.purpose: Agent answers in print-black on the ruling.

body-write.purpose: Student questions, composer and field values in ballpoint.

mark.purpose: Red-pen margin marks in Arabic (Aref Ruqaa).

mark-latin.purpose: Red-pen margin marks on lang=en, Literata italic 600; Ruqaa has no Latin.

label.purpose: Printed field labels on cover form rows, in spot.

shadows.name: sheet
shadows.purpose: The paper sheet and cover label panel resting on the cover. The only lift.

shadows.name: stamp-frame
shadows.purpose: Inner line of the stamp's double frame (with a 2px pen border). Print, not depth.

shadows.name: row-focus
shadows.purpose: Focus frame on a cover form row.

shadows.name: composer-focus
shadows.purpose: Ballpoint underline on the composer's focus.

motion.name: tick-draw
motion.purpose: Signature: the margin tick strokes itself in when an answer completes.

motion.name: pen-blink
motion.purpose: The red pen caret at the end of the answer being written.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Caret and tick render static under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce. Theme switching uses no transitions.

breakpoints.name: xs-name
breakpoints.purpose: Running head shows the product name.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Margin 3rem to 4.5rem; form header to four columns; cover rows go side by side; keyboard hint appears.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Auth cover goes to title column plus 28rem label panel.

components.name: Stamp
components.description: The red double-framed submit mark at the composer line's inline end; frame stays full ink at rest.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; height:2.5rem; min-width:4.5rem; padding:0 1rem; font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:600; color:hsl(var(--pen)); background:hsl(var(--paper)); border:2px solid hsl(var(--pen)); border-radius:0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--paper)), inset 0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--pen)); transition: opacity .2s, background-color .2s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-stamp:hover:not(:disabled) { background: hsl(var(--pen) / 0.08); } .ds-stamp:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ballpoint)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-stamp:disabled { color: hsl(var(--pen) / 0.6); cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Cover Submit
components.description: Solid cover-green action box closing a cover label panel.
components.css: .ds-cover-submit { width:100%; height:3.5rem; border:0; border-radius:0; background:hsl(var(--cover)); color:hsl(var(--cover-ink)); font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:600; transition: background-color .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-cover-submit:hover { background: hsl(var(--cover) / 0.9); } .ds-cover-submit:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--ballpoint)); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-cover-submit:disabled { opacity:.7; cursor:progress; }

components.name: Form Row Field
components.description: One bordered row of the cover label: printed label cell, then the ballpoint writing line.
components.css: .ds-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:8.5rem 1fr; background:hsl(var(--paper)); border-bottom:1px solid hsl(var(--spot) / 0.4); } .ds-row:focus-within { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--ballpoint)); } .ds-row-label { display:flex; align-items:center; padding:0 1rem; border-inline-end:1px solid hsl(var(--spot) / 0.4); font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:500; color:hsl(var(--spot)); } .ds-row-cell { padding:0 1rem; min-width:0; } .ds-row-input { height:3rem; width:100%; background:transparent; border:0; outline:none; font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; color:hsl(var(--ballpoint)); }

components.name: Running Head
components.description: Slim head on the cover: booklet mark and name, then printed text controls.
components.html: مساعد الجامعة
components.css: .ds-head { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; gap:.75rem; height:3.5rem; padding:0 2rem; background:hsl(var(--cover)); color:hsl(var(--cover-ink)); font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-head-brand { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.625rem; color:inherit; text-decoration:none; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-cover-control { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; height:2.5rem; padding:0 .75rem; background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:0; color:hsl(var(--cover-ink)); font:inherit; font-size:.875rem; transition: background-color .15s; cursor:pointer; } .ds-cover-control:hover { background: hsl(var(--cover-ink) / 0.1); } .ds-cover-control:focus-visible { outline:2px solid hsl(var(--cover-ink)); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Form Header Table
components.description: The sheet's printed header: university, major, date, question count.
components.css: .ds-formhead { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1.3fr 1fr auto; margin:0; background:hsl(var(--paper)); color:hsl(var(--print)); border-bottom:2px solid hsl(var(--print)); font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-formhead > div { padding:.5rem 1rem; border-inline-end:1px solid hsl(var(--spot) / 0.4); } .ds-formhead > div:last-child { border-inline-end:0; } .ds-formhead dt { font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:500; color:hsl(var(--spot)); } .ds-formhead dd { margin:0; font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:600; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.css: .ds-ruled { position:relative; padding:2rem 0; background-color:hsl(var(--paper)); background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent calc(2rem - 1px), hsl(var(--ruling)) calc(2rem - 1px)); background-size:100% 2rem; } .ds-margin-rule { position:absolute; top:0; bottom:0; inset-inline-start:4.5rem; width:5px; border-inline:1px solid hsl(var(--pen) / 0.6); } .ds-entry { display:grid; grid-template-columns:4.5rem minmax(0,1fr); } .ds-mark-col { display:grid; align-content:start; justify-items:center; } .ds-mark { font-family:"Aref Ruqaa",serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.375rem; line-height:2rem; color:hsl(var(--pen)); } .ds-meta { font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; line-height:2rem; color:hsl(var(--pen)); } .ds-q { margin:0; padding-inline:1.25rem; font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:500; line-height:2rem; color:hsl(var(--ballpoint)); } .ds-a { margin:0; padding-inline:1.25rem; font-family:"Literata","Noto Naskh Arabic",Georgia,serif; font-size:1.125rem; line-height:2rem; color:hsl(var(--print)); } .ds-tick { margin:.375rem 0; color:hsl(var(--pen)); } .ds-tick path { stroke-dasharray:24; animation: ds-tick-draw .55s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both; } @keyframes ds-tick-draw { from { stroke-dashoffset:24; } to { stroke-dashoffset:0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-tick path { animation:none; } }

components.css: .ds-composer { display:grid; grid-template-columns:4.5rem minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:start; padding-bottom:.5rem; background-color:hsl(var(--paper)); background-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent calc(2rem - 1px), hsl(var(--ruling)) calc(2rem - 1px)); background-size:100% 2rem; } .ds-composer-mark { text-align:center; font-family:"Aref Ruqaa",serif; font-weight:700; font-size:1.375rem; line-height:2rem; color:hsl(var(--pen)); } .ds-composer-input { min-height:2rem; max-height:12rem; resize:none; border:0; outline:none; background:transparent; padding-inline:1.25rem .75rem; font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:1.0625rem; font-weight:500; line-height:2rem; color:hsl(var(--ballpoint)); } .ds-composer-input::placeholder { font-weight:400; color:hsl(var(--spot)); } .ds-composer-input:focus-visible { box-shadow:0 2px 0 hsl(var(--ballpoint)); } .ds-stamp-c { margin-inline-end:1.25rem; height:2.5rem; min-width:4.5rem; padding:0 1rem; font-family:"Readex Pro",system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.9375rem; font-weight:600; color:hsl(var(--pen)); background:hsl(var(--paper)); border:2px solid hsl(var(--pen)); border-radius:0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px hsl(var(--paper)), inset 0 0 0 3px hsl(var(--pen)); } .ds-stamp-c:disabled { color:hsl(var(--pen) / 0.6); cursor:not-allowed; }

narrative.overview:
Every conversation is an exam answer booklet. A deep green cover frames a single sheet of cool paper. The sheet carries a printed form header with the student's university, major, date and question count. Below the header sits a light-blue ruled body with a double red margin rule on the inline-start side. The student writes questions in ballpoint blue on the next ruled line. The agent's answer is set in reading type below each question. The red margin holds the teacher's marks: the question number (س١ / Q1), the time, the answer mark (ج / A), and a tick that strokes itself in when the answer is done.

The system has no generic chrome. Every control is a mark the booklet would carry anyway: submit is a red double-framed stamp, the header controls are printed words on the cover, and form fields are bordered rows of a cover label. Density is calm and steady. Every line box on the sheet is one rule tall, so long sessions read like a filled-in page and never like a feed. The whole system is designed in RTL first and mirrors to LTR through logical properties, so the margin, the stamp and the booklet glyph all flip sides with `dir`.

The sheet rejects the chat-bubble thread and the floating, centered text box.
keyCharacteristics: Nine inks and nothing else, in light and in carbon-copy dark.
A 2rem ruling that is also the baseline grid.
A double red margin rule on the inline-start side that flips with the script.
Square corners, 1px printed cell borders, form-box tables.
Four faces with fixed jobs: print, reading, red pen, and an italic Latin fallback for the pen.
One signature motion: the margin tick drawing itself in.

rules.name: The Ink Discipline Rule
rules.body: Only the nine booklet inks exist. Never add a hex value or a Tailwind palette color. Tints are alpha on an existing ink (`/0.4` borders, `/0.08` stamp hover, `/0.2` selection). They are never new hues.

rules.name: The Carbon Copy Rule
rules.body: Dark mode is a carbon copy of the same booklet: a navy-black sheet, dim ruling, pale ink, and a deeper cover. Every ink keeps its role and changes only its value. There are no dark-only colors.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Every text ink meets WCAG AA (4.5:1) on its own ground in both themes. Measured: print on paper is 16.2 light and 15.2 dark, spot is 6.5 and 7.6, ballpoint is 8.6 and 9.2, pen is 4.75 and 7.4. Cover-ink on cover is 7.4 and 12.0, and cover-soft is 5.2 and 6.7. Light pen is the tightest pair, so don't lighten it or put pen text at an alpha.

rules.name: The Literal Reading Stack Rule
rules.body: The reading stack uses literal family names (`"Literata", "Noto Naskh Arabic", Georgia, serif`), not the next/font CSS variables. Each next/font variable carries a Times-based "Fallback" face that has Arabic glyphs and would shadow Naskh. The tailwind config keeps a `ponytail:` comment that explains this. Don't "fix" the stack back to variables.

rules.name: The Pen Has No Latin Rule
rules.body: Ruqaa has no Latin glyphs. On `lang="en"` the pen role switches to Literata italic 600, which is still the teacher's red hand.

rules.name: The Unspaced Arabic Rule
rules.body: Arabic is never letter-spaced. `html[lang="ar"]` forces `letter-spacing: 0` everywhere, including the display tracking.

rules.name: The Arabic-Indic Digits Rule
rules.body: Arabic pages format every number, date and time with `ar-u-nu-arab` (Intl), and ordered lists use `arabic-indic` markers, so the digits match across marks, header cells and lists.

rules.name: The Ruling Is The Baseline Rule
rules.body: The rule pitch `--rule` (2rem) is the line height of every line box on the sheet. Answer blocks are separated by exactly one rule. Headlines take two rules. The composer grows in whole rules, up to six. The `.ruled` background draws a 1px ruling line at the bottom of each 2rem band, and `background-attachment: local` keeps the ruling attached to the scrolling text.

rules.name: The Bilateral Margin Rule
rules.body: The margin column (`--margin`: 4.5rem, or 3rem below 640px) and the double red margin rule always sit on the inline-start side. They are built only with logical properties (`start-*`, `ps`/`pe`, `border-e`, `border-inline-start`, `margin-inline-start`), so they flip sides with `dir`. The margin never collapses, not even on phones. Never use physical `left`/`right`, `pl`/`pr` or `ml`/`mr` on the booklet.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only a sheet of paper casts a shadow. Content on the sheet stays flat, and structure comes from 1px printed borders.

dos: Do set every sheet line box to `leading-rule` (2rem) and separate blocks by whole rules.
Do use only logical properties on the booklet, so the margin and the stamp flip with `dir`.
Do put the student's words in ballpoint and the agent's answer in print, and keep red for the margin, the stamp and errors.
Do format numbers with `ar-u-nu-arab` on Arabic pages.
Do keep the stamp's frame at full ink when disabled, and dim only the word.
Do give every animation a `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` static state.
Do show focus: a 2px ballpoint outline on the sheet, cover-ink on the cover, and a 2px inset frame on form rows.
donts: Don't introduce colors outside the nine inks, or dark-only colors.
Don't round corners on cells, sheets, buttons or fields.
Don't set chat bubbles or a floating centered input. The composer is a ruled line.
Don't use Ruqaa outside margin marks, or for Latin text.
Don't swap the reading stack back to next/font variables.
Don't add shadows to anything except a sheet of paper.
